title: Assistant Manager/Manager
description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager / Manager – HR**

**Location:** Manesar  
**Work schedule:** 5 days a week  
**Experience:** 4–7 years  
**Qualification:** MBA in HR from a Reputed institute

**Role purpose**

Camfil India is looking for an HR professional to lead hiring for assigned functions and support day\-to\-day HR operations at its Manesar location. The role will be approximately **80% recruitment and 20% HR operations**. The final designation will depend on experience and the ability to manage hiring independently.

**Key responsibilities**

**Recruitment**

* Partner with hiring managers to understand manpower needs, role requirements and hiring timelines.
* Manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and joining.
* Build candidate pipelines for manufacturing, engineering, sales and support roles, as required.
* Work with recruitment partners while also strengthening direct sourcing and referrals.
* Keep candidates and hiring managers informed throughout the process.
* Track vacancies, hiring progress, offer acceptance and joining status; flag delays early.
* Support campus hiring and other talent pipeline initiatives.

**HR operations**

* Coordinate onboarding, joining documentation and induction.
* Support employee records, HR systems and routine employee queries.
* Coordinate with payroll and other teams on attendance, leave and employee data.
* Help implement HR policies and support employee engagement activities at the location.

**Candidate profile**

* 4–7 years of HR experience, with substantial hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end recruitment.
* MBA in HR from a Reputed institute.
* Experience hiring for a manufacturing or industrial business is preferred.
* Comfortable working directly with business leaders and managing multiple open positions.
* Strong follow\-through, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and proficiency in Excel and recruitment systems.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Current CTC
* Current Location

Work Location: In person

title: Total Rewards Market Partnership Expert
description:
**Total Rewards Market Partnership Expert**

 **Position Summary**

  

We are looking for an experienced Total Rewards professional to join our Regional Rewards Centre of Competence as a GPPT and Market Partnership Expert.

  

In this specialist role, you will provide strategic guidance and functional expertise across multiple markets, supporting the effective delivery of Total Rewards programmes, policies and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to market Total Rewards teams and senior stakeholders, providing advice on compensation strategy, annual reward processes, market benchmarking, job evaluation, pay structures and rewards governance.

  

The role offers an opportunity to shape Total Rewards practices across markets, lead key regional initiatives and build the capabilities of local Rewards teams.

 **Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic input and consultation to market Total Rewards teams in the design and implementation of local Total Rewards strategies, aligned with global and regional guidance and market priorities.
* Act as the primary Total Rewards point of contact for assigned markets, businesses, joint ventures, zones and categories.
* Partner with market Rewards teams to plan and execute annual compensation processes, including salary review budgeting, salary review execution, short\-term bonuses, long\-term incentives, job sizing, gender equal pay, living wage analysis and salary surveys.
* Support and lead Market Compensation Committees, ensuring that key reward decisions are reviewed and approved at the appropriate market, zone or corporate level.
* Analyse external compensation data, market trends and salary survey results to provide reliable insights and recommendations to business and HR stakeholders.
* Develop and review pay structures in partnership with local Rewards teams and conduct market pricing exercises for critical, new or high\-demand roles.
* Conduct job analysis and job evaluation activities, ensuring that positions are accurately understood, appropriately graded and managed in line with relevant governance requirements.
* Promote the simplification and standardisation of position evaluation processes across markets while maintaining high levels of data quality.
* Lead or coordinate regional and global Total Rewards projects, ensuring effective market coverage and delivery within agreed timelines.
* Support the transition of selected Rewards activities to shared service teams, ensuring a seamless process and positive employee experience throughout the transition and hypercare period.
* Ensure compliance with compensation policies and governance requirements, including appropriate documentation and approval of key reward decisions.
* Develop and deliver Total Rewards training programmes for HR and Rewards communities.
* Coach and mentor Total Rewards colleagues, particularly new team members, and contribute to capability\-building initiatives across the function.

 **What Will Make You Successful**

* A university degree or an equivalent qualification.
* At least five years of Human Resources experience gained within a large organisation with progressive people practices and/or an HR consulting environment.
* Strong experience in compensation, rewards, employee cost management or workforce budgeting.
* Practical knowledge of job analysis and job evaluation methodologies, such as IPE or an equivalent methodology.
* Experience in external market benchmarking, compensation analysis, market pricing and salary structure design.
* Strong understanding of annual compensation processes, including salary reviews, incentive programmes and long\-term incentive arrangements.
* Experience in developing and using HR metrics, KPIs and data\-driven insights.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse complex datasets and translate findings into practical compensation recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* The ability to influence without formal authority and build credible professional relationships across functions and geographies.
* Strong project\-management, organisational and time\-management capabilities.
* The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage demanding deadlines.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to contribute effectively within multifunctional and international teams.

 **Additional Experience That Would Be an Advantage**

* Experience working in the FMCG sector.
* Experience using SAP HR or similar HR systems.
* Knowledge of local employment law and labour regulations.
* A professional qualification in remuneration or compensation methodologies.
* Experience with compensation benchmarking tools and salary survey platforms, including Mercer tools or equivalent solutions.
* Exposure to international transfer management, including mobility packages, relocation, taxation and immigration considerations.

 **Key Stakeholders**

  

You will collaborate with market and regional Total Rewards teams, HR leaders, Finance, IT, corporate Rewards teams, shared service organisations and other internal stakeholders. You will also engage with salary survey providers, HR consultancies, compensation forums and external professional networks.

 **Why Join Us?**

  

This is an opportunity to apply your Total Rewards expertise in a highly collaborative and international environment. You will influence compensation strategy across multiple markets, contribute to regional and global Rewards initiatives, and help strengthen the capabilities of Total Rewards teams across the organisation.

 **Apply Now**

  

If you are an experienced Total Rewards professional with strong analytical capabilities, business acumen and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, we would welcome your application.

title: Head-Tendering
description:
**Company Description** **Assystem** provides engineering, project management and digital services to optimise the performance and safety of critical infrastructure throughout its lifecycle.


The company first came to India having acquired Stup Consultants Pvt Ltd in **2021** and **L\&TIEL** in **2024\.** The company combines its globally recognised expertise in complex project management, with deep\-rooted local experience cross full spectrum of infrastructure – from energy, transportation and urban development to water. Today, **Assystem** has a strong community of 1,500\+ multidiscipline engineering experts connected across 8 offices in India.


The Assystem Group is one of the world’s leading independent nuclear engineering companies, ranked among the top three globally, with 60 years of experience in complex and highly regulated environments. With 8,000 experts across 13 countries, Assystem supports the development of low\-carbon energy.

  

For company profile, please visit the website :\- https://assystem\-india.com/

 **Job Description**  

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the **end\-to\-end tendering and bidding process** for PMC, consultancy and infrastructure projects.
* Monitor and identify relevant **tenders, RFPs, EOIs, RFQs and EOI\-cum\-RFP opportunities** from government, PSU, multilateral agencies and private clients.
* Review tender documents, RFPs, TORs, eligibility criteria, technical requirements, commercial conditions and contractual provisions.
* Conduct **bid/no\-bid assessments** based on eligibility, technical capability, commercial viability, competition and strategic fit.
* Develop tender strategy, bid plans, submission schedules and responsibility matrices.
* Coordinate with technical teams to prepare **technical proposals, methodology, work plans, staffing plans and project organization structures**.
* Lead preparation and review of **EOIs, RFP responses, technical proposals, financial proposals and presentations**.
* Identify and evaluate suitable experts and professionals required for tender submissions.
* Coordinate with HR/recruitment teams for **CV sourcing, screening, compliance checking and preparation of CVs in prescribed RFP formats**.
* Ensure that proposed experts meet the **qualification, experience, age and project\-specific eligibility requirements** specified in the RFP.
* Coordinate with internal technical, commercial, finance, legal and contracts teams for bid preparation.
* Review BOQs, financial schedules, man\-month requirements, professional fees, reimbursables and other commercial components.
* Prepare and review **cost estimates, financial models and commercial bid submissions**.
* Ensure compliance with tender instructions, forms, declarations, affidavits, undertakings and submission requirements.
* Manage pre\-bid queries and coordinate preparation of **clarifications and responses to client queries**.
* Coordinate with consortium partners, JV partners, subcontractors and specialist agencies wherever required.
* Maintain a database of **ongoing, upcoming and submitted bids**, competitors, clients and project opportunities.
* Track tender outcomes and conduct **bid analysis / lessons learned** for unsuccessful and successful bids.
* Develop and maintain standard templates for technical proposals, CVs, project sheets, methodologies and tender documentation.
* Ensure all bids are submitted within stipulated deadlines with complete documentation and required approvals.
* Support management in developing **business development and tendering strategies** for targeted infrastructure sectors.
* Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, consortium partners and key stakeholders relevant to tender opportunities.
* Mentor and manage the tendering team and establish efficient bid management processes.

  

**Qualifications**  

Bachelor's degree in **Engineering / Architecture / Planning / Management** or related discipline. **15–20\+ years of overall experience**,

 **Additional Information**  

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

title: Business Process Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Analyzes and reports on pay\-for\-performance incentive outcomes, identifies data trends and root causes, and drives process improvements in a high\-volume, regulated environment. Partners with stakeholders to deliver accurate insights, ensure data quality, optimize processes, and enhance employee and leader experience through data\-driven decision\-making. Requires solid analytical, reporting, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Process Analysis \& Improvement
	+ Analyze incentive compensation processes to identify inefficiencies, defects, and opportunities for standardization
	+ Perform root cause analysis on data issues, payment discrepancies, and recurring errors
	+ Recommend and help shape implementation of process improvements to reduce rework and improve quality
	+ Monitor process performance and identify patterns or trends requiring escalation or resolution
	+ Partner with developers, consultants, and stakeholders to analyze processes, validate solutions, and guide implementation through enablement of scalable improvements Data Validation \& Insight Generation
	+ Validate monthly and quarterly incentive data to ensure accuracy and completeness
	+ Develop and deliver reporting that highlights trends, anomalies, and key performance insights
	+ Identify risks and patterns within large data sets and translate findings into actionable recommendations
	+ Contribute to the development of tools, controls, and workflows that enable scalable, high\-quality process execution
* Stakeholder Partnership \& Issue Resolution
* Partner with program consultants and business stakeholders to resolve data and process issues
	+ Manage inquiries by identifying underlying issues and driving resolution
	+ Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
	+ Appropriately escalate system issues with supporting analysis and context Process Execution \& Operational Support
	+ Execute core incentive processes with a high degree of accuracy, accountability, and timeliness
	+ Maintain documentation, templates, and process standards to support consistency and scalability
	+ Support onboarding, training, and change\-related activities for process updates
	+ Contribute to audit, compliance, and remediation efforts as needed
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate
* 1\+ years HR or Compensation experience
* 2\+ years of customer\-facing written communications skills including empathy and clarity
* Experience analyzing data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes
* Experience using Microsoft PowerPoint
* Solid critical thinking and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into insights
* Demonstrated ability to manage work independently and track deliverables accurately
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., data manipulation, pivot tables, analysis)
* Solid organizational, time management, and prioritization skills
* Ability to understand and navigate complex processes and systems

 **Preferred Qualification:**

* Experience with incentive compensation processes or Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) tools (e.g., Varicent)
* Experience with reporting, dashboards, or data visualization tools
* Experience with process mapping, workflow documentation, or continuous improvement concepts (e.g., Lean)
* Experience working in a high\-volume, data\-driven, or highly regulated environment
* Ability to independently learn and navigate complex systems, validate outputs, and self\-audit work for accuracy

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: HR Transitions Director, APAC
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Duties \& responsibilities
  
  

What this job involves –
  
  

HR Transition Management
  
o Accountable for the management of end\-to\-end execution of HR solution associated with outsourcing contracts and agreements
  
o Responsible for overall project management and direction for transition and integration activities, overseeing activities for multiple countries across Asia Pacific and Globally; must be able to manage multiple transitions at a time
  
o Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to implement critical recruitment activities to ensure placement of service delivery team on time and within budget
  
o Provide guidance to Geo HR team members to ensure the requirements of the HR solution and deal summary are fully understood and implemented through transition, Go Live, and post Go Live (business as usual)
  
o Act as a trusted consultant to key Client and internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, independently make decisions and meet Client requirements
  
o Implement risk management strategies and ensure employee transfer adherences to local legislation; ensure smooth and timely transfer of staff onto JLL HR and payroll systems
  
o Provide regular project updates to the Client and internal stakeholders
  
o Provide support to HR teams across the region to develop and share best practice approach to staff transfer activities
  
o Apply knowledge of business and HR principles involved in coordination of people and resources to identify improvement areas and implement best practice approach to employee transfer processes
  
o Manage effective handover to Regional HR Business Partner after transition service commencement
  
  

Stakeholder Management
  
o Define end\-to\-end transition plan including scope, timeline, recruitment plan, and risk mitigation plan to ensure smooth execution of HR transition activities
  
o Ensure continuous interaction with Client to understand Client’s requirements; must be able to influence and advise Client on complex processes related to employee transfer and recruitment
  
o Consult with internal and client stakeholders to identify and resolve any issues to avoid or minimise any disruption to service delivery
  
o Demonstrate flexibility within established process to meet Client’s requirements; navigate complex situations and make decisions in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to obtain agreed outcome that works for JLL and for the Client
  
  

Ad\-hoc Projects/Initiatives
  
o Instigate and lead process improvement projects as and when required
  
o Support new business, expansion and transformation as and when required
  
  

Candidate Specification
  
Experience
  
o Prior experience managing staff outsourcing in MNC environment; must be able to manage complex regional and global transitions to timeline and within budget
  
o Experience managing projects/programs with multiple priorities and executive level stakeholders
  
o Proven experience delivering HR activities and initiatives, consulting with multiple stakeholders to meet defined deadlines
  
o Experience dealing with multiple countries and cultures
  
  

Task Skills
  
o Analyse HR\-related data and prepare required reports/updates
  
o Ability to interpret and explain HR policies, procedures, or regulations and provide consultative advice to internal and client stakeholders
  
o Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  
o Good command of verbal and written English to influence, advise, and convey information effectively
  
  

Personal Skills
  
o Demonstrate critical thinking and decision making to reach mutually desirable outcome
  
o Be humble, agile and open to learning new technology and ways of working
  
o Ability to interact with a variety of stakeholders at all levels
  
o Analytical and complex problem\-solving skills
  
o People and service focussed with ability to collaborate effectively
  
o Ability to meet tight schedules and deliver high quality of work
  
o High level of communication and interpersonal skills
  
o Ability to excel in culturally diverse team across different geographies
  
  

Systems
  
o Microsoft Office
  
o Workday, Monday.com
  
  

Qualifications / Education
  
o Bachelor’s degree required, a Master’s degree preferred
  
o Minimum 8\-10 years of progressive experience within HR
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contract role  

  

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment, strong relationship\-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time\-off, payments, and work\-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de\-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third\-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave \& Disability management role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Global Head HR Risk and Compliance
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


As a Global Head of Human Resources Risk and Compliance, you will define and lead the global strategy that safeguards our people, strengthens governance and controls, and supports sustainable business growth across the United States, EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia\-Pacific), and India. Serving as a trusted advisor to senior Human Resources and enterprise leaders, you will anticipate emerging regulatory, operational, and reputational risks and translate them into proactive strategies and measurable actions. You will oversee a comprehensive framework for risk governance, compliance, controls, reporting, and audit readiness while driving consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across the Human Resources function. This is a highly visible leadership role with significant enterprise influence, global team leadership responsibilities, and the opportunity to build resilient, forward\-looking programs that strengthen compliance, mitigate risk, and enable responsible growth in an increasingly complex regulatory environment.**Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the global Human Resources risk and compliance strategy, establishing objectives and priorities that identify, assess, quantify, mitigate, and monitor risk across Human Resources.
* Oversee the design and execution of Human Resources operational risk management and compliance programs aligned with Enterprise Risk Management Committee, Chief Risk Officer, company, and regulatory expectations.
* Direct monthly and semiannual operational risk reporting, provide clear insights to senior leaders and governance forums, communicate feedback, monitor action plans, and escalate urgent issues.
* Maintain an effective global control environment through proactive risk analysis, control design and testing, regulatory change management, audit readiness, training, and timely remediation of compliance gaps and risk events.
* Provide senior oversight of compliance obligations involving employment and labor laws, employment eligibility, equal employment opportunity, affirmative action, data privacy, financial\-services regulation, and other jurisdiction\-specific requirements.
* Serve as a senior contact for internal and external auditors and regulators, coordinate regulatory reporting and examinations, influence outcomes, and ensure required follow\-up actions are completed.
* Lead, coach, and develop the global Human Resources Risk and Compliance team, strengthening subject matter expertise, consistent processes, accountability, collaboration, and an inclusive, high\-performance culture.
* Use analytics and trend intelligence to surface emerging risks, measure program effectiveness, close control gaps, and influence senior Human Resources leaders on required actions and investments.
* Build strong partnerships across Human Resources, Operational Risk Management, Risk and Control Services, Corporate Compliance, legal partners, control functions, and business leaders to deliver an integrated approach to risk management.
* Oversee Human Resources governance and training, including responsibilities related to the Financial Conduct Authority Senior Managers and Certification Regime and other applicable global regulatory frameworks.

 **Qualifications**

  

* 10\+ years of global leadership experience in Human Resources Risk and Compliance within complex, highly regulated environments, preferably in financial services.
* Demonstrated senior leadership experience developing risk and compliance strategy, overseeing operational processes and controls, advising executive leaders, and leading and developing teams.

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager on BCG’s IT HR Systems Group, you will serve as a hands\-on configuration expert across Workday, with deep focus on Advanced Compensation—designing, building, and maintaining salary, bonus, eligibility rules, and cycle frameworks—while also supporting configuration across Core HCM, Security, and other modules as needed to ensure cohesive, scalable system design aligned with business strategy. You will work with Global Comp Stakeholders and Product Team to translate BCG’s compensation strategy into scalable Workday solutions, combining technical configuration and functional expertise to ensure accurate execution of compensation cycles, data integrity, and continuous platform improvement

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources or information systems with 7\+ years of deep, hands\-on configuration experience with Workday Advanced Compensation and Core Compensation is a must
* Strong Understanding of merit pools, compensation review statements, proration rules, complex scorecards, grade setups, eligibility rules, etc. and integration points with Core HCM, Talent modules and third\-party payroll systems is a must
* Certification, such as Workday Pro \- Advanced Compensation, is strongly preferred.
* Prior Consulting experience as a Workday Comp Lead or an architect role on end\-to\-end implementation projects is strongly preferred
* Prior experience with large, global companies with complex enterprise\-scale comp implementations in Workday is strongly preferred
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans to ensure high quality before deployment is preferred
* Familiarity with Workday Docs and BIRT to build templates and control dynamic field visibility, and with Workday Security Configuration, is preferred
* Technical troubleshooting skills, including debugging and analysis of performance issues, are preferred
* Skilled in stakeholder management, offering training and support to end\-users during annual compensation cycles while delivering exceptional customer service year\-round for L3 support items is preferred

  

Who You'll Work With


The Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager will join a team of:

* Other members of the HR IT team, including the Workday Delivery Team, the Comp squad, and other squads under the People Portfolio
* Global Comp stakeholders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions
* QA Teams for testing on specific enhancements and software releases

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

  

Plan and Execute Comp Configuration: Design and build intricate variable pay, merit, bonus, allowances, including compensation review statements, and the overall coordination of events within Workday.  

Cycle Management: Own the end\-to\-end execution of Annual Salary Reviews, mass operation management, and merit grid setups.  

Business Processes: Configure Business Process Frameworks (BPF), condition rules, validations, and complex calculated fields.  

Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Product Team and HR/Compensation leaders to translate business strategies into scalable, system\-wide solutions  

Testing: Perform Testing, validate self and peer configurations, and troubleshoot system defects during Workday releases.  

Documentation: Create clear and comprehensive specification documents for application modifications and new functionality additions, for Workday  

Data Integrity \& Audits: Ensure the accuracy of compensation data and maintain internal compliance and audit processes.  

Workday Technology: Stay abreast of functional \& development tools, including Workday AI offerings, trends and practices, and act as an evangelist for items that should be considered for future initiatives

 *At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*  

  

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*  

  

*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork*

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Head of M365 platforms
description:
**Snapshot of the Day**
-----------------------


As the Head of M365 Platforms, you start your day reviewing platform health, adoption trends, AI capability usage, and transformation milestones across the global Microsoft 365 ecosystem. You engage with business leaders to prioritize productivity initiatives, align with cybersecurity and governance stakeholders on risk and compliance requirements, and guide your international leadership team on strategic priorities.


Throughout the day, you balance long\-term platform strategy with operational excellence, drive AI\-enabled innovation across productivity services, oversee major transformation programs, manage budget and vendor performance, and ensure employees worldwide benefit from secure, reliable, and modern workplace experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. AI\-First Strategy \& Workplace Innovation**

	+ Content management
	+ Low\-code solutions
	+ Productivity applications
	+ Analytics and reporting
	+ Service operations

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate them into measurable business outcomes.

* SharePoint and Enterprise Content Services
* M365 Backup and Recovery Services

* Build organizational capability in AI, automation, analytics, and modern workplace technologies.
* Drive succession planning, talent development, and workforce readiness.
* Empower teams through clear strategic direction and decision\-making autonomy.

### **4\. Financial \& Commercial Management**

	+ Operations
	+ Platform modernization
	+ Transformation programs
	+ AI\-enabled innovation initiatives
* Develop and present business cases demonstrating measurable value realization.
* Drive cost transparency, optimization, and demand management.
* Manage strategic suppliers, contracts, and service delivery partners to ensure performance and commercial value.

### **5\. Stakeholder Management \& Governance**

* Build trusted partnerships across business and functional leadership teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable platform strategy and roadmaps.
* Collaborate with:
	+ Cybersecurity
	+ Data Protection
	+ Legal
	+ Compliance
	+ Enterprise Architecture
	+ HR
	+ Communications
	+ Workers Council representatives
* Lead governance forums and decision\-making processes for strategic platform initiatives.
* Communicate strategy, investments, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Ensure change management, communications, and user adoption are embedded in transformation programs.

### **6\. Operational Excellence \& Transformation Delivery**

* Ensure secure, resilient, and highly available platform services.
* Establish and monitor KPIs covering:
	+ Availability
	+ User experience
	+ Platform adoption
	+ Security and compliance
	+ Cost performance
	+ Vendor performance
* Lead modernization and standardization initiatives across the global productivity ecosystem.
* Utilize analytics and user insights to continuously improve service quality.
* Proactively manage operational and transformation risks.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* Demonstrated success in developing and delivering AI\-first strategies that produce measurable business value.
* Strong expertise across:
	+ SharePoint
	+ M365 Backup
	+ Power Platform
	+ Online Applications
	+ Power BI
* Proven experience leading global teams and large\-scale cross\-functional transformation programs.
* Strong financial management experience including budgeting, forecasting, investment planning, and cost optimization.
* Experience collaborating with cybersecurity, privacy, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and vendor management skills.

---------------------------

Uses AI, automation, and data\-driven insights to reimagine digital workplace experiences and productivity platforms.

### **Strategic Operator**


Balances long\-term vision with disciplined execution and operational excellence.

### **Inclusive Global Leader**


Builds trust, accountability, and high performance across diverse international teams.

Effectively engages business leaders, governance bodies, cybersecurity teams, and employee representatives.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Business value and productivity gains delivered through AI\-enabled M365 capabilities.
* Platform reliability, security, compliance, and employee experience outcomes.
* Delivery of strategic roadmaps, modernization programs, and transformation milestones.
* Budget effectiveness, cost transparency, and supplier performance.
* Successful stakeholder alignment and governance execution.
* Team engagement, capability growth, succession readiness, and delivery excellence.

**Level**
---------

**Senior Executive (SE)**  

Global executive accountability for Microsoft 365 Productivity Platforms, encompassing strategy, AI\-first transformation, service ownership, financial management, stakeholder governance, and people leadership across a global organization.

title: Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
description:
### **Job Title**

Rewards Services Partner, Central Team
### **Job Description**

**Are you ready to help build something new?**

At Philips, meaningful careers are built by stepping into opportunities that challenge you, broaden your perspective, and enable you to make an impact with care.


The Central Rewards Services team was established in August 2026 to bring together shared activities across M\&A, analytics, equity, mobility, business travel, and operations. By combining our expertise, we aim to increase agility and strengthen global consistency.


As a Rewards Services Partner, you will join us at an important stage in our journey. You will help shape how the team works, contribute across disciplines, and grow your expertise beyond a single Rewards specialization.


**In this role, you have the opportunity to..**

Help build the future of Rewards Services at Philips. You will combine ownership of Global Mobility support for the APAC region with broader contributions to global Rewards processes, including annual compensation rounds, market benchmarking, analytics, and cross\-functional improvement initiatives.


This is intentionally a diverse and evolving role. The Central Rewards Services team is new, and not every responsibility or way of working has been fully defined. You will have the space to bring ideas, test better approaches, and take ownership where your experience, curiosity, and energy can create value.


You will work with specialists across the global Rewards landscape, learn from different disciplines, and help connect activities that have traditionally been managed separately. In doing so, you will strengthen both the employee experience and the consistency and effectiveness of our Rewards services.


The role is an opportunity to broaden your career as a Rewards professional while making a visible contribution to the success of a new global team.


**Your role**

* Own and coordinate Global Mobility activities for the APAC region, providing clear guidance and a consistent experience for employees and stakeholders.
* Contribute to global Rewards cycles, including annual compensation review processes, with a focus on accurate preparation, effective coordination, and high\-quality delivery.
* Support market benchmarking and Rewards analysis, translating data into clear insights that enable informed decisions.
* Work across Central Rewards Services activities, including equity, business travel, M\&A, analytics, operations, and Rewards Excellence, based on business priorities and team needs.
* Help design and embed new ways of working that reduce duplication, improve agility, and strengthen global consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, clarify ownership, improve service quality, and create an even better employee and stakeholder experience.
* Build strong partnerships with a multitude of stakeholders from a great variety of functions within the organisation to deliver connected solutions.
* Use data, technology, and AI responsibly to improve insights, efficiency, and service delivery.
* Share knowledge, learn from colleagues across disciplines, and contribute to building capability within the Central Rewards Services team and the wider Rewards community.
* Take ownership beyond established boundaries when new priorities emerge, balancing flexibility with sound judgment and reliable delivery.

**The impact you can make**

Your contribution will go beyond delivering individual processes. You will help turn a newly established team into a connected and trusted global partner by:


* Ensuring a consistent, employee\-focused Global Mobility experience across the APAC region.
* Helping global Rewards processes run smoothly and deliver reliable outcomes.
* Connecting expertise and activities across Central Rewards Services so that work is performed where it creates the most value.
* Bringing forward practical ideas and turning them into improvements that can be scaled globally.
* Helping build a team culture based on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

**You're the right fit if you have:**

* A Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Global Mobility, Compensation, Rewards, HR Operations, or a related discipline.
* Interest in broadening your expertise across multiple Rewards areas rather than remaining within one specialization.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn data and complexity into clear insights and practical actions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills in a global, matrixed organization.
* The ability to organize priorities, deliver reliably, and adapt when business needs change.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and the confidence to question existing approaches constructively.
* Curiosity, creativity, and flexibility, together with a willingness to step outside your comfort zone.
* The judgment and discretion required when working with confidential employee and business information.
* AI literacy and an interest in using technology to improve how Rewards services are delivered.

**You will thrive in this role if you...**

* Are energized by the opportunity to help create, not only to maintain.
* Can bring structure to ambiguity without waiting for every detail to be defined.
* See change as an opportunity to learn, contribute, and improve.
* Enjoy moving between regional delivery, global processes, analysis, and project work.
* Build trust through collaboration, openness, and follow\-through.
* Want to broaden your Rewards expertise and help a new team become a success.

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.  



  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.

  

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.

  

What You'll Bring

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.

  

Who You'll Work With


You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.

  

The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.

  

Additional info


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
